messages:
Sam (presales): Quick sync — ACME pilot wants streaming + function/tool-calls + structured JSON output. They also need SSO/KMS answers and a pricing estimate for ~100k req/day. Who can help with handshake/telemetry?
Nina (eng): I can own the SDK integration. Do they want SSE or WS? WS gives better two-way toolcall semantics.
Sam (presales): They prefer WebSocket. Also asked for ephemeral creds + example for token rotation.
Raj (solutions): We can support ephemeral creds via short-lived tokens. For the POC we usually do a 24h token rotation and a simple refresh endpoint. Need to confirm if they require customer-managed KMS for key wrapping.
Elaine (security): For Hosted we offer CMEK for enterprise customers; Private can integrate with their on-prem KMS/HSM. We'll need the completed security questionnaire item on key access and audit logging. Can someone share the SSO flow?
Nina (eng): SDK already supports OIDC flows. Example snippet for WS auth: ```
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream', {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
});
// send toolcall: {"type":"tool","name":"lookup","args":{...}}
```
Sam (presales): Perfect. Also customer asked about structured output schema validation and fallback behavior if model returns malformed JSON.
Raj (solutions): For POC we recommend the structured-output shim: 1) schema validation on runtime, 2) deterministic retry with the same prompt + explicit schema enforcement, 3) fallback to text mode. I'll add sample prompts and a mini-eval.
Lina (sales-ops): On pricing — rough ballpark for 100k req/day with streaming and ~50 concurrent sessions: estimate $7k–$18k/month depending on model family and reserved capacity. If they commit to Dedicated we can give a lower rate + 3-month POC credits. I'll run a more exact calc with expected token volumes.
Sam (presales): Thanks — can you include bandwidth and egress assumptions in the calc? They operate in EU so region pricing matters.
Lina (sales-ops): yup will include eu-west pricing and an option for burst capacity.
Elaine (security): Action item: ACME must fill the KMS access matrix and SSO IdP metadata. I'll review once they provide.
Raj (solutions): I'll assemble a POC runbook: handshake steps, token rotation, telemetry hooks (trace id in each message), success criteria (latency, error rate, schema pass rate).
Nina (eng): I'll add an SDK sample repo with a small harness that simulates 50 concurrent streams and validates structured output.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of streaming-handler v2 succeeded in eu-west — 2/2 instances healthy. :tada:
Sam (presales): Great — timeline: Raj/Nina to share runbook + sample by EOD Wed, Lina to share pricing estimate, Elaine to send KMS checklist. I'll ping ACME for IdP metadata. :thumbsup:
Raj (solutions): On it. I'll post the runbook link here once ready.
Nina (eng): ETA Wed EOD for sample harness.
Lina (sales-ops): Pricing estimate in progress, target Thu morning.
Elaine (security): KMS checklist sent to ACME contact.
Sam (presales): Thanks all — closing the loop here.
